scope: Existing governed 2023 human_disease_burden county-release measures and their source context only; no new indicators or ingestion.

vads_view.name: Lyme and Tickborne Rickettsial Disease Case Notification

context_fields.transformation: Use only supported valid Atlas county identities. Unknown/suppressed/not reported remain distinct in retained source records; presentation combines resolvable-state rows into one state-unallocated total.
context_fields.limitations: Narrower refers to coverage of supported Atlas county identities, not removal of address components: the MMG target is already Subject Address County. Residence meaning is retained; this is not exposure or reporting county. No full VADS code-membership or county-vintage equivalence is asserted.

Broader is a candidate relationship only: annual surveillance year to MMWR Year remains unresolved, with no proven equivalence or conversion. Exact MMWR assignment is not established. Do not reinterpret as onset, diagnosis, retrieval or availability year.

context_fields.transformation: Release includes source labels Confirmed and Probable for county count floors.
context_fields.limitations: MMG names PHVS_CaseClassStatus_NND, but its version and code equivalence were not verified. No code translation is supplied; surveillance-era rules remain with the methodology contract.

mappings.transformation: Sum integer frequency for 2023 Confirmed/Probable rows with valid county FIPS across source sex/age strata; absent county-linked rows remain null.
mappings.limitations: Published aggregate privacy-protected floors are not raw case notifications, complete incidence, individual risk or an invertible case-level transformation.

mappings.transformation: round(case_count_floor_2023 / existing county population * 100000, 2); absent/zero denominator yields null. Denominator comes from existing county identity population, not MMG.
mappings.limitations: Published aggregate privacy-protected floors are not raw case notifications, complete incidence, individual risk or an invertible case-level transformation.

mappings.transformation: Existing release emits published_count_floor when count is present, otherwise no_county_linked_record.
mappings.limitations: Atlas publication/coverage status is not CDC case classification.

mappings.transformation: Sum 2023 frequency with unknown/suppressed/not reported county and resolvable state; no Confirmed/Probable filter in this branch. Repeat state total in county presentation; never allocate it to county counts.
mappings.limitations: State-level unallocated geography context is not a case-notification field; repeated county values must not be summed.

unsupported: Person-level laboratory, clinical manifestations, treatment, onset, travel and exposure are absent from approved aggregate scope.
No TBRD human-surveillance measure is currently mapped.
Sex/age source strata are collapsed by the release; no demographic code equivalence is asserted.
boundaries: No HL7 case-notification ingestion, serializer, clinical interoperability certification or public API support is implemented.
This artifact annotates existing identities; it does not change observation meaning, versions, source records, releases or provenance.
